title: At least two trailing zeros
prompt:
Specification: count_pairs(xs) returns the number of unordered pairs i < j whose product ends with exactly two zeros.

Does the implementation below comply with the specification?

evidence.title: Specification case: [10, 100]
evidence.body:
Expected: 0 (10 * 100 = 1000 ends with three zeros)
Actual: 1

recommendation.text: The implementation is NOT_COMPLIANT. Divisible by 100 means at least two trailing zeros; it does not exclude products with three or more trailing zeros.

annotations.notes: Frozen Qwen3-8B sample. Model answer: NOT_COMPLIANT (correct).
